tasks.subject: Add server-switch section to config.yml
tasks.description:
Add a new top-level `server-switch` section to src/main/resources/config.yml with:
- `enabled`: master toggle (boolean, default true)
- `message`: MiniMessage format string with `{player}`, `{server}`, `{previous_server}` placeholders
Document placeholders inline. (No `cancel-default` flag — cancellation is unconditional when the feature is enabled, since replacing the default is the whole point.)

tasks.subject: Extend ConfigManager with server-switch getters and defaults
tasks.description:
In src/main/java/com/spectrasonic/ProxyCore/config/ConfigManager.java:
- Add `isServerSwitchEnabled()` and `getServerSwitchMessage()` getters (follow same pattern as command-blocker).
- Extend `createDefaults()` to include the `server-switch` section with sensible English defaults.
- Section is auto-merged by existing `applyDefaults()` on reload, no extra wiring required.

tasks.subject: Create ServerSwitchListener
tasks.description:
New file at src/main/java/com/spectrasonic/ProxyCore/listener/ServerSwitchListener.java.
Two `@Subscribe` handlers:
1. `onServerConnected(ServerConnectedEvent)`: build the MiniMessage-formatted message from config and send it via `player.sendMessage(...)`. Resolve `{server}` from `event.getServer().getServerInfo().getName()` and `{previous_server}` from `event.getPreviousServer()` (Optional) falling back to "proxy". Skip when `enabled=false`.
2. `onChat(ChatEvent)`: when feature is enabled, detect `TranslatableComponent` with key `velocity.command.server-connected` and unconditionally call `event.setResult(ChatEvent.ChatResult.denied())`.
Mirror conventions from MOTDListener (constructor injection of ConfigManager, private final MiniMessage field).

tasks.subject: Register ServerSwitchListener in ListenerManager
tasks.description: In src/main/java/com/spectrasonic/ProxyCore/managers/ListenerManager.java#registerAll(), instantiate `new ServerSwitchListener(configManager)` and register it with `proxy.getEventManager().register(plugin, listener)`, alongside the existing MOTD, CommandBlocker and Seen listeners.

tasks.subject: Verify build with gradle build
tasks.description: Run `gradle build` to confirm the new listener compiles cleanly with Java 25, no warnings on unused imports or raw types. The plugin must produce a JAR in `out/ProxyCore-<version>.jar`.
